This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER 1.

This is second bail application filed under Section 439 CrPC on behalf of applicant in connection with Crime No.331/2022, registered at Police Station Nasrullahganj, District Sehore (M.P.), for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 450, 323, 506 of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.

First bail application filed by applicant was dismissed on merits on 13.07.2022 in M.Cr.C.No.22239/2022.
2.
Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 18.05.2022.

sentences.text: Prosecutrix has already been examined in Court.
There is no chances that applicant will be able to influence witnesses.
Applicant is no longer required in jail custody.
Applicant is first offender and aged about 30 years.
In these circumstances, applicant may be released on bail.
3. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the respondent/State as well as counsel for Objector opposed the prayer for grant of bail.
It is submitted that prosecutrix has stated that applicant had violated her.
There is clear evidence against him.
In these circumstances, repeat bail application may be dismissed.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
5.
Applicant is in jail for more than six months.
Investigation in the case is over.
Prosecutrix has already been examined in Court and there is no chances that applicant will be able to influence prosecutrix or tamper with evidence of the case.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, repeat bail application filed by the applicant is allowed on condition that applicant will regularly attend trial and will not leave district without permission of the Court.

7. It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.
8. The applicant shall abide by the conditions stipulated in Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C. C.C as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE nd Manoj Uikey vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26918149/
